math_expression:
For 16x16 intra prediction modes (8-bit baseline):
VERT: for y in 0..15: for x in 0..15: dst[y*stride+x] = top[x]
HOR:  for y in 0..15: for x in 0..15: dst[y*stride+x] = left[y]
DC:   s = sum_{i=0..15} top[i] + sum_{i=0..15} left[i]; dc = (s + 16) >> 5; for y,x: dst[y*stride+x]=dc
TOP_DC:  s=sum_{i=0..15} top[i]; dc=(s+8)>>4; fill 16x16 with dc
LEFT_DC: s=sum_{i=0..15} left[i]; dc=(s+8)>>4; fill 16x16 with dc
128_DC: fill 16x16 with 128
PLANE: compute H = sum_{i=1..8} i*(top[7+i]-top[7-i]); V = sum_{i=1..8} i*(left[7+i]-left[7-i]); a = 16*(left[15]+top[15]); b=(5*H+32)>>6; c=(5*V+32)>>6; for y,x: dst[y*stride+x] = clip( (a + b*(x-7) + c*(y-7) + 16) >> 5 )
notes: pred16x16 is a function-pointer table (multiple modes) initialized per bit_depth. For RVV, prioritize 8-bit NEON-referenced modes: dc/top_dc/left_dc/128_dc/vert/hor/plane. Core vector work: (1) sum reductions of 16 bytes (top/left) for DC variants; (2) store 16 bytes per row with stride; (3) plane uses weighted butterfly-like diffs to form H/V and then per-pixel affine ramp with final rounding shift; clipping/bitdepth saturation needed in plane (clip to [0, 2^bit_depth-1]) though not shown in provided context; tail not required since width is fixed 16.
